protocol_checks.item: RAW key names and camera order
protocol_checks.note: the frozen format spec declares exactly these keys; a present-but-reordered cache is reported as a mismatch because camera order is part of the protocol

protocol_checks.item: storage dtype and the declared conversion rule
protocol_checks.note: the frozen loader keys the conversion off the stored dtype: uint8 -> float32/255 and floating -> unchanged (rawvla_sequence.RawVLAWindowDataset._calibrate)

expected.note: the 8-dim proprio read at the same step as the observation; the cached 92-dim `states` array is simulator state and is never used as a policy input

protocol_checks.note: a companion 16-dim robot_states array may exist on RoboTwin; it is recorded but is not the joint state
the window rule is a declared protocol; the audit can only confirm that the loader default agrees and that each file has enough action rows

expected.formal_statistics: quantile and the author gripper rule

protocol_checks.note: the loader default is the declared formal statistics for this platform
the NPZ records no executed-action trace, so the number of actions the frozen policy executed per inference is a protocol constant, not an audited field

protocol_checks.item: camera key order in each file
protocol_checks.note: streams are synchronised; the order identifies which camera is which
a frame-index-only cache cannot support exposure-time reasoning; the loader reports time_unit='frame' and timestamp=None in that case
without a declared noise model no variance may be fabricated; an estimated scale stays an estimate and any energy built from it is not a posterior
language is declared context, never a hidden-truth channel

protocol_checks.item: action units and normalisation statistics fingerprint
protocol_checks.note: the hash covers the empirical per-column statistics of the file's own action array, not the author's normalisation constants

limits: each file is read fully to measure min/max; quantiles use an evenly strided subsample of at most 1048576 elements and report quantile_kind
the executed-action window and the author's normalisation constants are not stored in the NPZ, so those checks are declared-only
notes: evidence_kind='real_cache_sample' was declared by the caller; this audit reports measured facts and never infers that a root is the deployed cache
